fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that a loan agent collected Rs. 8,00,000 from the complainant for approving a personal loan and then stopped answering calls. The matter was brought to Thoothukudi Port PS on 2025-09-09, while the incident was placed on 2025-09-08 at roughly 17:50. Anitha Raj reported the matter orally at Thoothukudi Port PS; the contact number given was 9000000399. A further person, Murugan Babu, a relative of the suspect, using the number 9000000070, is stated to be associated with the incident. Funds were reportedly sent to the account reference SYN-ACC-100033. A witness, Abirami Sri, reachable on 9000000096, was mentioned in the complaint. A person named Sathish Subramani, associated with the number 9000000429, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. The complainant mentioned social media screenshots.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Agent reportedly claimed a guaranteed approval and became unreachable.
fields.Keywords: loan fraud, processing fee, mobile number, suspect, witness, receiving account, screenshot, residential colony
